posts.title: TNTD / Total Neurotypical Death
posts.description:
TNTD is an acronym for Total Neurotypical Death, a slang term supporting the idea of a society in which only neurodivergent people exist and neurotypical people are eradicated, playing into the idea of neurodivergent supremacy. The term, which is largely used in an ironic manner, is a reference to the white supremacist hate acronym "TND," meaning "total n----r death."

In April 2026, the acronym "TNTD" went viral on sites including TikTok and X / Twitter as a meme, in which it is placed over clips referencing autism and the idea of "autistic supremacy." The memes often include the flag of Mesa, Arizona, which was declared the first "autism-certified city" in 2019.
posts.keywords: neurotypical, autism, neurodivergent supremacy, autism supremacy, tntd, tntd meaning, tntd slang, total neurotypical death, internet slang, neurodivergent, tiktok, ironic memes

posts.title: Send Me To Gary, I Want To Be With Gary
posts.description:
Send Me To Gary, I Want To Be With Gary is an exploitable image macro and reaction meme format using a scene from Rick and Morty in which the character Jerry forces Beth to aim a gun at his head while saying, "Send me to Gary, I want to be with Gary," attempting to get Beth to shoot him.

The scene originates from Rick and Morty season two, episode four, titled "Total Rickall." It first became the subject of memes as early as January 2020 on X / Twitter and spread over the following years. As a meme, the name "Gary" is often replaced with another person or character's name, using the phrasal template "Send Me To X, I Want To Be With X." The earliest known example of the meme reads, "Send me to Xxxtentacion, I want to be with Xxxtentacion."

posts.title: Family Guy Running Down Stairs
posts.description:
Family Guy Running Down Stairs or Griffin Family Running Downstairs is a series of memes based on a scene from Family Guy in which the Griffin family runs down the stairs into the basement with serious expressions on their faces. The clip is often edited to feature louder, more intense stepping sounds.

As a meme, the scene is often used as a reaction image and attached to captions using the phrasal template, "There's X upstairs," with "X" being a subject like "good writing" or "Arby's," with the clip being used to represent someone avoiding the subject. The meme was popularized on X / Twitter and TikTok throughout April 2026.

posts.title: Avatar Aang Movie Leaks
posts.description:
Avatar Aang Movie Leaks, also known as The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender Full Movie Leak, refers to viral leaks of the upcoming Avatar: The Last Airbender (ATLA) film Avatar: Aang, The Last Airbender. The film, officially set to release on October 9th, 2026, leaked in full online (with content from other Nickelodeon properties) in mid-April 2026.

The incident was widely discussed on X / Twitter, where one user claimed to have been erraniously emailed the entire film by Paramount. Despite uploads rapidly being DMCAed and taken down, more continued appearing across multiple sites in the following days as the incident continued garnering attention.

posts.title: Sabrina Carpenter Yodeling / Zaghrouta Reaction
posts.description:
Sabrina Carpenter Yodeling Reaction or Sabrina Carpenter Zaghrouta Reaction is a reaction image of pop artist Sabrina Carpenter with a confused look on her face after hearing someone in the crowd of her Coachella 2026 performance doing a Zaghrouta, a Middle Eastern cheer. A video of Carpenter's reaction went viral in mid-April 2026, following her performance.

The clip inspired controversy over the following days about the way she reacted to the cheer, calling it "weird" and describing it as a "yodel." Carpenter apologized shortly after the clip went viral, explaining that she couldn't see or hear them and didn't know what a Zaghrouta was. Carpenter's face also went viral as the subject of memes in mid-April 2026, displaying the image alongside captions that joke about reacting with disgust to a given subject, similar to the Disgusted Homelander meme.
